verdict.rationale: Pulley is a SaaS cap-table and equity-management platform. Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an API, API keys, or scoped or least-privilege credentials, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
